description: This file defines the 'FieldBlock' class for Drupal's layout builder module, providing a block that renders a specific field from an entity with configurable formatter options and access control.

classes.name: FieldBlock
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class that provides a block rendering a specific entity field with configurable formatter and access control.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the FieldBlock with dependencies and extracts entity type, bundle, and field name from plugin ID.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Retrieves the entity associated with this block from context.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the render array for the field, handling exceptions and cacheability.

methods.name: getPreviewFallbackString
methods.description: Provides a fallback string for preview mode, showing the field label.

methods.name: blockAccess
methods.description: Determines access permissions for viewing the block based on entity and field permissions.

methods.name: defaultConfiguration
methods.description: Returns default configuration for the block, including formatter settings.

methods.name: blockForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form for the block, including formatter options.

methods.name: formatterSettingsProcessCallback
methods.description: Processes and builds formatter settings form elements via AJAX.

methods.name: thirdPartySettingsForm
methods.description: Builds third-party formatter settings form elements.

methods.name: formatterSettingsAjaxCallback
methods.description: AJAX callback to retrieve formatter settings form elements.

methods.name: blockSubmit
methods.description: Saves the block configuration submitted via form.

methods.name: getFieldDefinition
methods.description: Retrieves the field definition for the configured field.

methods.name: getApplicablePluginOptions
methods.description: Returns formatter options applicable to the field's type.

methods.name: getFormatter
methods.description: Creates and returns a formatter instance based on form input or default configuration.

methods.name: entityFieldHasDefaultValue
methods.description: Checks if the field has a default value set.
